blocks.text: Flaming Head lowered himself toward Laura's bound hands.
Behind him, Daniel stripped the canvas off the collector and hit the switch.
The hum shuddered through the roof. Flaming Head turned and rose, but his flame bent toward the brass funnel. He tried to slip past its edge. The pull caught him and dragged him backward.
His fire streamed into the glass. His face followed it through the narrowing throat.
From the vent, Laura watched his enormous eyes widen beyond the first copper coil as he fought to get back to the mouth.
Daniel caught his slipping glasses and bent over the controls.
Laura felt a smile beginning. He could not float away from her now.
blocks.alt: The uncovered collector draws Flaming Head through its brass intake while bound Laura watches from the vent.

blocks.text: Luke rose beside the panel as both needles climbed.
Orange light raced around the copper coils. Inside the glass, Flaming Head surged toward the intake and was thrown back. A strip of flame tore from his crest.
Luke drifted closer to the storage meter. His uncle had captured it. The power that might give him a body was gathering inches from his face.
Daniel turned the knob. The hum deepened.
Flaming Head stopped struggling long enough to find Laura.
“Are you hurt?”
His voice reached her alone, inside her mind. Daniel and Luke could not hear him.
Laura lifted her chin.
“I asked him to do this.”
blocks.alt: Luke watches the collector’s two analog meters rise while Daniel operates the controls; a single trapped Flaming Head glows inside the cylinder.

blocks.text: Flaming Head's eyes closed as another bright tongue of fire pulled away into the coils.
Laura's smile vanished.
The machine drew him toward the closed end of the cylinder. His crest flattened against the glass, rose weakly and flattened again. A strained sound reached her through their connection.
Her bound hands tightened in her lap.
Even now, his worried eyes kept returning to her bindings. Behind the bright bands of stored energy, his little orange face was growing dim.
blocks.alt: Still bound against the rooftop vent, Laura watches in alarm as Flaming Head’s flame diminishes inside the collector.

blocks.text: “Turn it off!”
Daniel glanced at her without lifting his hand from the knob.
“It's not full.”
He turned back to the rising needle.
Laura looked to Luke. He hovered over the western controls, the switch just below his jaw. For an instant their eyes met. Then he looked back at the meter.
Inside the cylinder, Flaming Head tried to lift his flame. Only a short flicker rose above his brow before the machine stripped it away.
Laura lifted her bound hands. The joining rope drew taut between her wrists and the turns across her coat.
She twisted her paired gloves until the short span stood clear of the cloth. There was no time to work at the knot.
She lowered her chin and took aim.
blocks.alt: Laura angles the accessible rope away from her coat and lowers her chin to take aim; her bindings are still intact.
